page_title: RAY 3-0 OVI | Rayo Vallecano v Oviedo 04/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
90+2' The corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared away by the defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
90+1' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
88' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Pathe Ciss.
88' Substitution. Alvaro Garcia leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alemao (Rayo Vallecano).
87' A first-time shot by Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
84' Augusto Batalla pulls off a great save to deny Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
82' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
79' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
79' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Oviedo comes to nothing.

76' Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Augusto Batalla has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Oviedo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
76' Luka Ilic (Real Oviedo) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

75' Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
74' Here is a change. Federico Vinas is going off and Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves gives the last tactical orders to Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo).
69' A substitution has been made. Ilias Akhomach goes off and Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
69' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' The corner is swung in but Oviedo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Jorge de Frutos.
65' The referee signals a substitution. Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Pedro Diaz.
63' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano).
62' 3 - 0 After the keeper softly punches the ball away, it lands at the feet of Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) who knows what to do with it and sends it into the middle of the goal.

62' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Aaron Escandell makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
61' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to substitute Santiago Colombatto and he is replaced by Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo).
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Luka Ilic (Real Oviedo) coming on for Haissem Hassan.
58' Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
58' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
56' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
53' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Hernandez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

52' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Hernandez with no other option than to blow for a foul.
50' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Aaron Escandell no chance!
49' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is going to take the penalty!
48' Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
47' Rayo Vallecano force their opponents to concede a corner.

46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ilyas Chaira. He is replaced by Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Kwasi Sibo is replaced by Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The foul by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) was seen by Alejandro Hernandez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
40' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
39' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
38' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
36' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
35' Today's referee Alejandro Hernandez rightly decides to book Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) for his harsh tackle.
34' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
32' Oviedo are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
30' Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
29' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
29' A quickly taken corner by Rayo Vallecano.
28' Ilias Akhomach (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
23' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
21' Aaron Escandell (Real Oviedo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

20' What an opportunity! Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post! The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.
18' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
15' Great teamplay by Oviedo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
12' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

8' Ilias Akhomach (Rayo Vallecano) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
7' The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.
5' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

5' That didn't go as planned! Ilias Akhomach (Rayo Vallecano) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Aaron Escandell, who easily kept it out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
4' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Rayo Vallecano will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Alejandro Hernandez.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
